lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Directly above the pectoral fin insertion, a cluster of four primary spots forms a quadrangular arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular spots to form a grid-like pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the upper surface to shadow on the lower surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense population of smaller, lower-contrast spots is concentrated on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
